name: entalkenator-library
description: A private, self-hosted library and podcast feed for enTalkenator programs, on one Cloudflare Worker (R2 + D1, free plan).

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: Lets the enTalkenator plugin upload and edit items. Use a long random value (32+ characters), for example the output of `python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"`. Put the same value in the plugin's **library_token** setting.

FEED_TOKEN.description: The secret part of your private podcast feed address (32+ random characters, made the same way). Anyone with the feed address can listen, so don't share it. Change it to revoke every old address.

APP_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase for the web library at `/app` (10+ characters) when **AUTH_MODE** is `passphrase`. Leave any value if you use Cloudflare Access instead.

AUTH_MODE.description: `passphrase` (the Worker shows a sign-in page) or `access` (Cloudflare Access protects `/app`; see the README).

ACCESS_AUD.description: Only for `access` mode: the Access application's **Application Audience (AUD) Tag**.

LIBRARY_TITLE.description: The library's name in podcast apps and the web app.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for audio, transcripts, chapters and .enTalkenator bundles. The free plan includes 10 GB.

DB.description: D1 database holding the library index.
